_readme: Ten real BAWABA funding records conforming to SeedDatasetSchema (packages/ingestion/src/seed-manifest.ts). Every expected* value is a HYPOTHESIS the pipeline must confirm against the official source; UNKNOWN is used wherever official evidence is insufficient (live egress is BLOCKED in the build env). No confirmed facts and no scores are carried here. localArtifact values match localFilename values in data/artifacts/manifest.json.

records.title: Hub71 Access — Cohort 20
records.notes: Confirm from the live Hub71 source: exact cohort deadline, incentive structure (in-kind vs SAFE), any ADGM incorporation/onboarding or relocation requirement. Distinguish ability-to-apply from incorporation. Do not assert VERIFIED, a deadline, PURSUE or ELIGIBLE_NOW without the live source. Live fetch BLOCKED; no local artifact supplied for this record.

records.title: Bpifrance — Aide au Developpement Deeptech (France 2030)
records.notes: officialUrl is the innovation-aids hub, not the specific programme page — replace with the exact programme/application URL once confirmed on bpifrance.fr. Verify: open/rolling status, applicant requirements, whether Oolala France SAS qualifies as applicant, amount and mechanism (subvention vs advance).

records.title: EIC Accelerator (Open)
records.notes: Do NOT default to ELIGIBLE_AFTER_NEW_ENTITY. Oolala France SAS already exists — determine from the official rules whether it can be the applicant (IP ownership/control, stage fit, EU establishment/relocation rules). Return UNKNOWN if unclear. Confirm next cut-off and Open vs Challenge scope.

records.title: DIGITAL-2026-AI-DATA-10-COMPLIANCE — Digital solutions for regulatory compliance through data
records.notes: Official portal topic page is a client-rendered SPA; the supplied artifact is that page captured via Print to PDF. Verify exact call title, topic id, deadline, consortium requirements, eligible participants and budget from the artifact. Do not copy aggregator values (previously seen EUR 8.5M / EUR 2-5M are aggregator-sourced and unconfirmed).

records.title: DIGITAL-2026-AI-09-GENAI-PA — Apply AI: GenAI for the public administrations
records.notes: Closed call (submission deadline passed). Classify the CALL as closed -> REJECT for PURSUE. Any downstream supplier route (public-administration pilots procuring solutions) must be a SEPARATE record with its own official evidence; none is available yet, so no downstream record is asserted here. Confirm closed status and topic details from the AI-09 call fiche.

records.title: Startup Qatar Investment Program — START
records.notes: Verify from the official QDB page: title, current status/intake, instrument (equity/grant/blended), maximum support, and the Qatar incorporation requirement plus timing (rolling vs fixed). The GCC-local-entity route is a hypothesis to confirm, not asserted.

records.title: NSF SBIR/STTR (America's Seed Fund) — eligibility
records.notes: Keep eligibility UNKNOWN in the seed. The pipeline must derive any structural ineligibility from the official ownership/establishment/operational requirements in the artifact, not from nationality assumptions. Verify the ownership rule and whether it conclusively blocks a UAE/FR-owned applicant.

records.title: UNESCO RFP (UNGM Notice 300342) — AI governance / data-protection legislative support (Ukraine)
records.notes: Expired (submission deadline passed ~May 2026) -> REJECT. Keep expired status, applicant eligibility and product relevance SEPARATE; do NOT label structurally ineligible merely because expired. Full notice documents on UNGM require login (authenticated); live fetch BLOCKED and no artifact supplied. Confirm expiry from the official notice.

records.title: Aggregator lead: 'Digital Europe — Advanced Digital Skills for AI Uptake in Health' listed with USD figures
records.notes: Aggregator-only lead. No official issuer source located; USD figures on an EU (EUR) grant are a red flag. No confirmed financial facts. Must never reach VERIFIED or PURSUE from this source alone; resolve to an official europa.eu / HaDEA source before any extraction or scoring.

records.title: Call document: DIGITAL-2026-AI-09 (Digital Europe) — exact PDF extraction fixture
records.notes: PDF extraction mechanics fixture on the official AI-09 call fiche. Target a named topic with PDF_PAGE locators (e.g. DIGITAL-2026-AI-09-DS-HEALTH-TOOL, or GENAI-PA ~p.23): exact topic id, title, submission deadline, budget/funding rate. Purpose: prove per-page locators are retained and that an unreadable/scanned PDF is flagged for manual review, never fabricated. Shares the AI-09 fiche artifact with record digital-2026-ai-09-genai-pa (different test angle).
